JThetaAttachment.translatedSource_equivariance.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [MeasurableMul (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (a alpha s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (g : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K) (f : JThetaAttachment.AdmittedSource K addHaar mu chi a alpha s) :
  (Masullo.NativeRep.nativeTranslationCLM K mu alpha s ha hs ↑g) (JThetaAttachment.sourceVector K f) =
    JThetaAttachment.sourceVector K (JThetaAttachment.translatedSource K addHaar mu chi a alpha s ha hs g f)

  [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] (a alpha s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (g : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)
  (f : JThetaAttachment.AdmittedOriginalSource K addHaar mu a alpha s) :
  (Masullo.NativeRep.nativeTranslationCLM K mu alpha s ha hs ↑g) (JThetaAttachment.originalSourceVector K f) =
    JThetaAttachment.originalSourceVector K (JThetaAttachment.translateOriginalSource K addHaar mu a alpha s ha hs g f)

JThetaAttachment.originalBruhat_theta_summable.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K → ℂ) (hf : JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K) :
  Summable fun u => f ↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) u * x)

JThetaAttachment.full_source_admission_iff.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (addHaar : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (a alpha s : ℝ) (f : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K → ℂ) :
  (∃ F, F.test = f) ↔
    JThetaAttachment.IsOriginalBruhat K f ∧
      f 0 = 0 ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable f addHaar ∧
          ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K), f x ∂addHaar = 0 ∧
            MeasureTheory.MemLp (JThetaAttachment.normalizedTheta K a alpha s f) 2 mu
